recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-17285 unless a future Patient Care decision changes the Extension Pack asserted-date extension text or the later consolidation that made condition-assertedDate cover both Condition and AllergyIntolerance.
issue_request: FHIR-17285 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for STU3 asking to clarify how Condition.clinicalStatus and assertedDate should be understood over time. The final resolution moved assertedDate from AllergyIntolerance and Condition core resources to an extension and added core recordedDate as the date this particular record was created in the EHR/system.
initial_application: Git commit 722ed5c93f4bc9828e96f0f5b476bedc3486fb92 on 2018-06-19 explicitly cites GF#14643, GF#15781, and GF#17285 and applies the requested change by replacing the core assertedDate elements with recordedDate and adding assertedDate extension definitions in the then-current source spreadsheets. Current converted StructureDefinition XML retains GF#17285 committee notes on both recordedDate elements.
additional_context: FHIR-14643 and FHIR-15781 were same-family Published trackers for Condition.assertedDate and AllergyIntolerance.assertedDate ambiguity, and their comments say GF#17285 superseded them for recorded-vs-asserted clarification. Zulip discussion shows the original clinicalStatus/assertedDate ambiguity and Michelle Miller summarized the Patient Care resolution to move assertedDate to an extension and add recordedDate to core. The Extension Pack now carries condition-assertedDate for both Condition and AllergyIntolerance, while allergyintolerance-assertedDate is retired/deprecated in favor of condition-assertedDate.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source edit is needed because active core source has AllergyIntolerance.recordedDate and Condition.recordedDate with definitions/comments distinguishing first recording from recorder/asserter, no core assertedDate elements remain, and fhir.ini preserves R3 rename aliases from assertedDate to recordedDate.
